Questions about pricing
Online plans are bought by card, in annual or monthly packs of invites. Enterprise plans are annual and tiered by the products, integrations and support you need. Each tier includes a generous fair usage limit, and if you outgrow it, you move up a tier at renewal.
An invite counts when you send it. If the candidate has not started, you can cancel the invite and it returns to your allowance, as long as you cancel within the same billing period. On Enterprise plans, invites count toward your fair usage limit.
On an online plan, you move to the next pack, and assessments already in progress carry on. Teams that need more than 1,400 invites a year, or single sign-on and more integrations, move to an Enterprise plan.
Yes. Every plan covers Screen assessments and live Interviews, drawn from the same invite allowance.
On online plans, the AI Assistant runs on models up to Sonnet class, and Claude Code and Codex are set up in the terminal. Enterprise plans add frontier models in live interviews. Every prompt and command is saved with the candidate’s result.
Yes. Every plan includes the AI Assistant, Claude Code and Codex. Claude Code and Codex run in the terminal, set up before the session starts, so candidates need no API key. You switch AI on or off for each task or interview, and every prompt, command and code change is saved for your team to review.
Yes, on Enterprise plans. Codility assesses AI skills for sales, marketing, finance, operations and customer roles, and Skills Intelligence assesses the people you already employ.
Your hiring team makes the decision. No AI or machine learning makes hiring decisions, selected task types are scored against fixed rules, and every interaction with the AI Assistant, Claude Code or Codex is recorded for human review. The Technical Manual sets out how scoring works, for your legal team to review.
Yes. Our team scopes trials to your roles, volume and products, then reviews the results with you. On the first call, we confirm the evaluation scope and provide quick access if you qualify.
A specialist contacts you to confirm the products, roles and support you need, usually on a short call, then sends a proposal. If you want to see the product first, the call can include a walkthrough on your own roles.
Yes. Talk to us at any point in your term and we will move you to the Enterprise tier that fits.
Your account manager can add Interview, Skills Intelligence or AI skills assessment for business roles to your plan. If you are not sure who that is, use the form on this page and select I’m an existing customer.
Platform users create assessments, review results and manage settings. Collaborators join interviews and review candidate submissions. Every plan includes unlimited collaborators.
Single sign-on (SSO) with SAML 2.0 is available on Enterprise plans, with admin roles and permissions. Our team sets it up with your identity provider.
Codility integrates with more than 20 applicant tracking systems (ATS) and HR systems, including Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, iCIMS, Greenhouse, SmartRecruiters, Lever, Ashby and Workable. Your team invites candidates from the ATS, and results return to the candidate record. Online plans include one standard integration, such as Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby. Every integration is available on Enterprise plans.
The SOC 2 Type II report, the ISO 27001 certificate, the data processing agreement and a completed CAIQ are in the Codility Trust Center at trust.codility.com. Our team answers your own security questionnaire, and Enterprise plans are bought by contract and invoice.
